items.title: How does the payback period change as the numbers shift?
items.description: This reproduces the invoice-reconciliation ROI case from L3: a $3,988/month cost of inaction, a $1,200/month subscription, and a $2,900 one-time implementation cost, with the team realizing only about half the eventual savings during the first 3 weeks of ramp-up. Drag the sliders to see how the payback period changes — at the defaults it lands at 7 weeks, matching the worked example.
items.compute: const netMonthlyFull = params.costOfInactionMonthly - params.subscriptionMonthly; const weeklyFull = netMonthlyFull * 12 / 52; const weeklyRamp = weeklyFull * 0.5; let balance = -params.oneTimeAdoptionCost; let week = 0; const maxWeeks = 520; while (balance < 0 && week < maxWeeks) { week++; balance += week <= 3 ? weeklyRamp : weeklyFull; } const paybackWeeks = week < maxWeeks ? week : 520; return { paybackWeeks };
